title_zh: 王菲：被称为「天后」的独特嗓音歌手
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (18/20): Faye Wong, the "Diva" with a One-of-a-Kind Voice
note_en: In 她的声音比很多歌手更独特 "her voice is more distinctive than many singers'," 比 introduces what is being compared, and the adjective stays in its plain form, since Chinese has no -er or "more" endings. 更 is optional and adds emphasis ("even more"), but 很 cannot appear in a 比 sentence: 比很多歌手很独特 is wrong.
